rules.condition: AHB write is to Device-E (bufferable Device memory)
rules.statement: The bridge must not merge Device-E (bufferable Device memory) writes.

rules.condition: AHB write is to Device-E (bufferable Device memory)
rules.statement: The bridge must wait for the final-destination BRESP before completing a Device-E write.

rules.condition: AHB read address has not yet been accepted
rules.statement: The bridge must not issue an AXI read before its AHB address has been accepted (no speculation).
